<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Prima lezione | Proxi</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Personalized standalone lesson synthesized by Proxi">
  
  <!-- Early Theme Init Script to Prevent FOUT -->
  <script>
    (function() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("learn-forme-theme");
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      const activeTheme = savedTheme || (prefersDark ? "dark" : "light");
      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", activeTheme);
    })();
  </script>

  <!-- KaTeX CSS & JS CDN -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/katex.min.css" crossorigin="anonymous">
  <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/katex.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
  <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

  <!-- Mermaid JS CDN -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@10/dist/mermaid.min.js"></script>

  <style>
    /* ==========================================================================
       CSS Custom Properties / Design Tokens
       ========================================================================== */
    :root {
      --font-body: Charter, "Bitstream Charter", "Sitka Text", Cambria, Georgia, serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      --font-ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Monaco, "Cascadia Code", "Roboto Mono", Consolas, monospace;
      
      --max-width: 72ch;
      --radius-sm: 6px;
      --radius-md: 10px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
      --transition-smooth: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    /* Light Theme */
    :root[data-theme="light"] {
      --bg: #fcfbfa;
      --fg: #1c1917;
      --bg-canvas: #fcfbfa;
      --bg-surface: #ffffff;
      --bg-surface-elevated: #ffffff;
      --bg-subtle: #f4f3ef;
      --bg-code: #f1f0eb;
      
      --text-primary: #1c1917;
      --text-secondary: #44403c;
      --text-muted: #6b645f;
      --text-link: #0369a1;
      
      --border-default: #e7e5e0;
      --border-subtle: #f0eee8;
      
      --step-motivate-border: #f59e0b;
      --step-motivate-bg: #fffbeb;
      --step-motivate-text: #92400e;
      
      --step-connect-border: #10b981;
      --step-connect-bg: #ecfdf5;
      --step-connect-text: #065f46;
      
      --step-quiz-border: #8b5cf6;
      --step-quiz-bg: #f5f3ff;
      --step-quiz-text: #5b21b6;
      
      --badge-axiom-bg: #ccfbf1;
      --badge-axiom-text: #0f766e;
      --badge-derivation-bg: #e0e7ff;
      --badge-derivation-text: #3730a3;

      --quiz-ok: #047857;
      --quiz-ok-on: #ffffff;
      --quiz-err: #b91c1c;
      --quiz-err-on: #ffffff;

      --mermaid-theme: default;
    }

    /* Dark Theme */
    :root[data-theme="dark"] {
      --bg: #0f172a;
      --fg: #f8fafc;
      --bg-canvas: #0f172a;
      --bg-surface: #1e293b;
      --bg-surface-elevated: #283548;
      --bg-subtle: #192434;
      --bg-code: #0b1120;
      
      --text-primary: #f8fafc;
      --text-secondary: #cbd5e1;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --text-link: #38bdf8;
      
      --border-default: #334155;
      --border-subtle: #1e293b;
      
      --step-motivate-border: #fbbf24;
      --step-motivate-bg: #451a03;
      --step-motivate-text: #fde68a;
      
      --step-connect-border: #34d399;
      --step-connect-bg: #064e3b;
      --step-connect-text: #a7f3d0;
      
      --step-quiz-border: #a78bfa;
      --step-quiz-bg: #2e1065;
      --step-quiz-text: #ddd6fe;
      
      --badge-axiom-bg: #134e4a;
      --badge-axiom-text: #5eead4;
      --badge-derivation-bg: #312e81;
      --badge-derivation-text: #c7d2fe;

      --quiz-ok: #34d399;
      --quiz-ok-on: #052e1f;
      --quiz-err: #f87171;
      --quiz-err-on: #2a0a0a;

      --mermaid-theme: dark;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
        --bg: #0f172a;
        --fg: #f8fafc;
      }
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem);
      line-height: 1.68;
      background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      transition: background-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease;
    }

    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem 6rem 1.25rem;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
    }

    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.25;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    h1 { font-size: 2.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    h2 { font-size: 1.65rem; margin-top: 2rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }

    p { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
    p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    a {
      color: var(--text-link);
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 3px;
    }
    a:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

    .theme-toggle-container {
      position: fixed;
      top: 1.25rem;
      right: 1.25rem;
      z-index: 1000;
    }

    .theme-toggle-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: 9999px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      cursor: pointer;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .theme-toggle-btn:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .lesson-header {
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      padding-bottom: 2rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
    }

    .lesson-tagline {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .lesson-meta-bar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .badge-axiom, .badge-unconditional-truth {
      background-color: var(--badge-axiom-bg);
      color: var(--badge-axiom-text);
    }

    .badge-derivation {
      background-color: var(--badge-derivation-bg);
      color: var(--badge-derivation-text);
    }

    .badge-status {
      background-color: var(--bg-subtle);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
    }

    .diagram-container {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      margin: 1.75rem 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      overflow-x: auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .diagram-title {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .svg-figure {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      margin: 1.75rem 0;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    .svg-figure svg {
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }

    .svg-figure figcaption {
      margin-top: 0.875rem;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .cognitive-node {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 2rem;
      margin: 2.5rem 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .cognitive-node:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .node-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      padding-bottom: 1rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }

    .node-title-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    .node-number {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .node-title {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .step-motivate {
      background-color: var(--step-motivate-bg);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--step-motivate-border);
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
      margin: 1.25rem 0;
      color: var(--step-motivate-text);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .step-label {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .step-establish {
      margin: 1.5rem 0;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .node-steps {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      margin: 1.5rem 0;
    }

    .node-step {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .node-step .step-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .node-step .step-id {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .node-step .step-title {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .node-step .step-content {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .step-connect {
      background-color: var(--step-connect-bg);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--step-connect-border);
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
      margin: 1.25rem 0;
      color: var(--step-connect-text);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .step-quiz {
      background-color: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-top: 3px solid var(--step-quiz-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      margin: 1.75rem 0;
    }

    .quiz-question {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .quiz-instruction {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .quiz-options {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .quiz-option-item {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .quiz-option-btn {
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.85rem;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-default);
      padding: 0.85rem 1.15rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .quiz-option-btn:hover:not(.is-disabled) {
      border-color: var(--step-quiz-border);
      background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .quiz-option-letter {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .quiz-option-text {
      flex: 1;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .quiz-option-status {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .quiz-option-btn.is-answered-correct {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1) !important;
      border-color: var(--quiz-ok) !important;
      color: var(--step-connect-text) !important;
    }

    .quiz-option-btn.is-answered-correct .quiz-option-letter {
      background: var(--quiz-ok) !important;
      color: var(--quiz-ok-on) !important;
      border-color: var(--quiz-ok) !important;
    }

    .quiz-option-btn.is-answered-correct .quiz-option-status {
      color: var(--quiz-ok);
    }

    .quiz-option-btn.is-answered-wrong {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1) !important;
      border-color: var(--quiz-err) !important;
      color: var(--quiz-err) !important;
    }

    .quiz-option-btn.is-answered-wrong .quiz-option-letter {
      background: var(--quiz-err) !important;
      color: var(--quiz-err-on) !important;
      border-color: var(--quiz-err) !important;
    }

    .quiz-option-btn.is-answered-wrong .quiz-option-status {
      color: var(--quiz-err);
    }

    .quiz-option-btn.is-disabled {
      cursor: default;
    }

    .quiz-feedback-banner {
      padding: 0.9rem 1.15rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      margin: 1rem 0;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.925rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .quiz-feedback-banner.is-correct-banner {
      background-color: var(--step-connect-bg);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--step-connect-border);
      color: var(--step-connect-text);
    }

    .quiz-feedback-banner.is-wrong-banner {
      background-color: var(--step-motivate-bg);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--quiz-err);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .katex-error {
      color: var(--quiz-err) !important;
    }

    .quiz-feedback-title {
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .quiz-action-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    .quiz-retry-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.825rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: 9999px;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .quiz-retry-btn:hover {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border-color: var(--border-default);
    }

    .quiz-reveal {
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }

    .quiz-reveal summary {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-link);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .quiz-explanation {
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      font-size: 0.925rem;
    }

    .step-capture {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    details.deep-dive {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      margin: 1.25rem 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    details.deep-dive summary {
      padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    details.deep-dive[open] summary {
      border-bottom-color: var(--border-default);
    }

    details.deep-dive .details-content {
      padding: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    pre, code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.9em;
    }

    code:not(pre code) {
      background: var(--bg-code);
      padding: 0.2em 0.4em;
      border-radius: 4px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
    }

    pre {
      background: var(--bg-code);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin: 1.25rem 0;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .math-card {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 1rem;
      margin: 1rem 0;
      overflow-x: auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .summary-panel {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 2px solid var(--border-default);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 2.25rem;
      margin: 3rem 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .summary-panel h2 {
      margin-top: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
      padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .truth-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin: 1.25rem 0;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .truth-table th, .truth-table td {
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      text-align: left;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
    }

    .truth-table th {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
    }

    @media print {
      :root {
        --bg-canvas: #ffffff !important;
        --bg-surface: #ffffff !important;
        --bg-subtle: #fafafa !important;
        --text-primary: #000000 !important;
        --text-secondary: #222222 !important;
        --border-default: #cccccc !important;
      }
      
      body {
        padding: 0;
        color: #000;
        background: #fff;
      }

      .theme-toggle-container {
        display: none !important;
      }

      .cognitive-node, .diagram-container, .summary-panel {
        box-shadow: none !important;
        border: 1px solid #ddd !important;
        break-inside: avoid;
        page-break-inside: avoid;
        margin: 1.5rem 0;
      }

      details.deep-dive, details.quiz-reveal {
        display: block !important;
      }

      details.deep-dive summary, details.quiz-reveal summary {
        display: none !important;
      }

      details.deep-dive .details-content, details.quiz-reveal .quiz-explanation {
